# Aether support

Aether is pre-release software. The maintainers do not currently provide a
service-level agreement, production support contract, or guaranteed response
time.

## Get help

- Read the [development guide](../docs/development/getting-started.md) and
  [architecture](../ARCHITECTURE.md).
- Search existing
  [Discussions](https://github.com/SingularityCoLabs/Aether/discussions) and
  [Issues](https://github.com/SingularityCoLabs/Aether/issues).
- Start a Discussion for setup questions, design exploration, and general
  usage help.
- Open a bug report only for reproducible incorrect behavior.

When asking for help, include the Aether commit or version, operating system,
relevant tool versions, minimal reproduction steps, and sanitized logs.

## Security

Do not include vulnerabilities, credentials, private keys, production data, or
personal information in a public discussion or issue. Follow
[SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) to report vulnerabilities privately.
